summary: A Quote subscription on an NSE equity: AliceBlue's tk snapshot, then a tf delta that sends 0 for the unchanged open, become Quote frames; after the unsubscribe a tick still in flight reaches nobody.

notes: Both keep the last non-zero price when a delta sends 0 (aliceblue_adapter.py:663-690; brokers/aliceblue/streaming.rs FeedSnap::apply).
The login and its ck answer go through the desktop's loopback relay, with the REST socket session created first (a fake REST endpoint in tests/it/feed_corpus/aliceblue.rs).

deviations.reason: The desktop's data carries the symbol, exchange, mode label and receipt timestamp in every frame, as every broker's do on the desktop and the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry them (docs/api/websocket-streaming/ltp.md shows timestamp); this web adapter's dict has none of them (aliceblue_adapter.py:1243-1305).

The desktop's data carries the symbol, exchange, mode label and receipt timestamp in every frame, as every broker's do on the desktop and the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry them (docs/api/websocket-streaming/ltp.md shows timestamp); this web adapter's dict has none of them (aliceblue_adapter.py:1243-1305).
The web's AliceBlue data carries no mode; data.mode follows each broker's web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): closed by the per-broker dialect switch.

The desktop's data carries the symbol, exchange, mode label and receipt timestamp in every frame, as every broker's do on the desktop and the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry them (docs/api/websocket-streaming/ltp.md shows timestamp); this web adapter's dict has none of them (aliceblue_adapter.py:1243-1305).

The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft unchanged as ltt, a string of epoch seconds ("1794302700"); feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds as numbers (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in ms.
AliceBlue's tick carries last_quantity (ltq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent. The desktop sends it.
AliceBlue's tick carries total_buy_quantity (tbq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent. The desktop sends it.
AliceBlue's tick carries total_sell_quantity (tsq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent. The desktop sends it.
The web sends AliceBlue's pc as change_percent for every instrument; the desktop sends the change (and this alias) for indices only today.
The web's Quote sends AliceBlue's toi as total_oi; the desktop's Quote carries no OI (C05) and has no total_oi alias.
